Package neqsim.process.mechanicaldesign.separator.internals

Class InternalOperatingWindow

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.mechanicaldesign.separator.internals.InternalOperatingWindow
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class InternalOperatingWindow extends Object implements Serializable
Describes the Souders-Brown K-factor operating window of a separator internal (mist eliminator, vane pack, cyclone deck) and where the current operating point sits inside that window.

Demisting internals only perform well within a band of gas load. The band is expressed as a K-factor window [Kmin, Kmax] where:

K-factor window interpretation
Region Physical meaning
K < Kmin Below the effective turndown limit: too little inertial capture and poor film drainage / coalescence, small droplets slip through.
Kmin ≤ K ≤ Kmax Good performance band: the internal operates at its rated grade efficiency.
K > Kmax Above the capacity limit: flooding and re-entrainment of captured liquid off the element face.

K-factor limits are sourced from the SeparatorInternalsDatabase (open literature: Brunazzi & Paglianti 1998, Phillips & Listak 1996, Hoffmann & Stein 2008, GPSA Engineering Data Book).
